info.title: OwnSteps API
info.description: API for the OwnSteps apps. Authors authenticate with a device token (`osa_…`), readers with a viewer token (`osv_…`) for one trip. Only additive changes happen within v1.

get.description: Redirects to the identity provider. Ends at `ownsteps://auth?code=…&state=…` (or `?error=…&state=…`).
